authority_rule: Repository commits, generated PDFs, structured catalogs, validators, and polished prose do not independently prove approval; they must reconcile to this ledger and in-universe board approval records.

records.subject: J2 identity
records.decision: J2 stands for Judgment & Junction and is an internal Sable Harbor institutional capability, not a legal entity or customer-facing business line.

records.subject: J2 logos
records.decision: Official J2 identity is the selected concentric-circle mark and selected horizontal mark plus red block J2 identity; generated alternate identities are rejected.

records.subject: J2 structure
records.decision: J2 has small Headquarters, Contact, Judgment, Orientation, Junction Advisory Group, and Education. Contact/Judgment/Orientation is a workflow loop, not HR reporting.

records.subject: J2 Headquarters
records.decision: HQ is small and holds doctrine, standards, Daedalus doctrine, professional stewardship, priority arbitration, and continuity; exact title/reporting/billets remain open.

records.subject: Contact
records.decision: Contact is the collection apparatus, not a think tank and not self-directing; Orientation sets broad priorities, Judgment Officers set problem RFIs, HQ arbitrates scarcity, and Contact chooses lawful methods and provenance.

records.subject: Collection disciplines
records.decision: Six collection disciplines: systems, human, JAG, external, exploitation, and directed observation/evidence creation.

records.subject: Judgment Officers
records.decision: Judgment Officers are human problem owners/case officers with commissions, broad inquiry rights, no line command, Problem Books, Open Problem Hours, Judgment Table challenge, and private calibration records.

records.subject: JO portfolio
records.decision: Working portfolio is approximately five problems: four directed and one mandatory bounded self-directed curiosity problem.

records.subject: Judgment Watch
records.decision: Judgment Watch belongs to Judgment and works at Contact intake for triage, correlation, routing, and problem formation; it does not own resulting problems.

records.subject: Orientation
records.decision: Orientation owns EIB, enterprise questions/assumptions, changes of mind, reorientation, dissent travel, intellectual history, Canon, and epistemic integrity in decision environments.

records.subject: Orientation vocation
records.decision: Orientation Officer is a vocation; ordinary commissioned officers permanently forfeit later C-suite, operating VP/line authority, voting board membership, and equivalent decision power.

records.subject: Orientation corps
records.decision: Working corps target is about 20-25 commissioned officers; exact rank titles and former Head non-executive-director eligibility remain open.

records.subject: Anti-court controls
records.decision: Orientation Officers may not own budgets, line staff, personnel actions, executive gatekeeping, political brokering, private intelligence leverage, or future power conversion; no forensic influence/blame graph is created.

records.subject: Junction Advisory Group
records.decision: JAG is field-facing connective tissue, not command/audit/punishment; standard five billets are Team Lead, Data Scientist, Technical Systems Advisor, Operational Advisor, and Human Systems Advisor.

records.subject: JAG tour
records.decision: Approximate one-year tour with first 30-45 day embed, build/test period, second 30-45 day embed, and final 90 day stewardship phase; six teams/about 30 billets is working scale.

records.subject: Education
records.decision: Education is a separate J2 arm; J2 owns pedagogy and delivery design for deep and mandatory compliance training, while Legal/Safety/HR/Compliance may own required subject matter.

records.subject: EIB
records.decision: EIB is normally about two pages, five categories with no more than five items each, enterprise-visible by default, and a discussion-starting front door into Alexandria.

records.subject: Immaculate Intelligence
records.decision: Sable Harbor aligns people around important questions, not only conclusions; maximum useful visibility and minimum necessary restriction.

records.subject: Question visibility
records.decision: Questions are common property and propagate wider than answers; restriction follows information nature, creates ownership/review/challenge, and access failure is an intelligence failure.

records.subject: Alexandria
records.decision: Alexandria is the umbrella institutional intelligence environment and crown-jewel internal system; it preserves, connects, and orients so Sable Harbor does not lose what it learns.

records.subject: Pinakes
records.decision: Pinakes is Alexandria's human-facing catalog/portal, not primarily invisible ontology; Pharos as main portal is superseded.

records.subject: Pinakes doors
records.decision: Nine doors: EIB Archive, Finance, Judgment, JAG Knowledge, Semaphore, Canon, Business Lines, Collection, Education. Daedalus is not a tenth door.

records.subject: Semaphore
records.decision: Semaphore is the cable-like intelligence/decision traffic system; durable, searchable, threaded, referential, supersession-aware, historically navigable, and human-authored by Orientation Officers.

records.subject: Canon
records.decision: Canon is the institutional knowledge corpus: what Sable Harbor can responsibly say it knows at a point in time; uncertainty can be canonical; Orientation owns it; material change uses two Orientation Officers and Head deadlock resolution.

records.subject: Daedalus
records.decision: Daedalus is the AI agent around Alexandria; it may hold, pull, trace, reconstruct, challenge, explore, compare, visualize, synthesize, converse, and form labeled opinions.

records.subject: AI authority
records.decision: Daedalus boundary is institutional authority, not thought: no authoritative record write, no self-promotion, no institutional authority; human professionals author institutional records.

records.subject: Personal instance
records.decision: Daedalus is personally provisioned with segregated persistent memory; users may share content-free skills/practices but not private memory or Alexandria extracts.

records.subject: Board paper trail
records.decision: User authorized retroactive in-universe board approvals and cogent paper trail for governance, J2, Alexandria, and controlled-document structures, with timelines and meetings that make sense.
